task_summary: Executed complete database wipe across all MongoDB collections, flushed Redis, cleared MinIO S3 bucket, initialized Academic Foundation (Academic Year 2025-2026, Course BSIT, Sections BSIT-4A to 4D, Global SystemSettings), and reseeded all official BukSU users and canonical test accounts with default password Password123! and strictly 0 projects, 0 teams, and 0 submissions.
lessons_learned: Lesson: When wiping all collections for a clean user-only restart, the Academic Foundation (AcademicYear, Course, Sections) and singleton SystemSettings must always be re-seeded alongside users, otherwise students navigating to /profile cannot bind their Section or select Course Instructors.
Lesson learned: Ensure all seeded student records have teamId: null and panelAssignments: [] to guarantee a pristine Phase 0 (Team Formation & Roster Locking) testing environment.

Prevention: When connecting to MongoDB from host scripts in hybrid Windows/Docker environments, specify candidates in order of accessibility (127.0.0.1:27018 -> localhost:27018 -> mongodb:27017) with an explicit serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 3000 to prevent long DNS resolution socket stalls.
